hypothesis: A valid www/apex HTTPS redirect must not be classified as evidence unavailability or an unhelpful website.

reproduction.before: All three initial observations were rejected as cross-origin, and an incoming request was prematurely closed as ineligible.
reproduction.after: Seven bounded public observations returned HTTP 200 after the demonstrated canonical www/apex redirect.

implementation: Accept only demonstrated ordered HTTPS redirect chains within the exact www/apex hostname pair. Reject unrelated domains/subdomains, external intermediate hops, credentials, nonstandard ports, malformed provenance and unproven alias changes.
Use the observed successful homepage URL for sitemap selection and same-origin page sampling; retain requested URL and ordered redirect provenance.
Store unavailable collection evidence privately and keep the request in needs_review without inference or payment, rather than assert a useful-report rejection.
Add redacted request inspection and an explicit single-request diagnostic retry; terminal paid requests and no-useful-task decisions are excluded. Preserve routine two-request bounds.

controls: www to apex and apex to www
unrelated/unsafe origins and external redirect hops
targeted retry does not select other customers, paid jobs or ordinary no-action decisions
